def objs(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','g') and 20<=n['pixels']<=30:
            b=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in b); c0=min(p[1] for p in b)
            out.append((n['color'],(r0,c0)))
    return out
print("before SPACE", objs(current_frame))

# also check red pixel count
def redpx(fr):
    return sum(n['pixels'] for n in fr.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='R')
print("red before/after:", redpx(previous_frame), redpx(current_frame))
